Source

Really catchy 7/8 tune by Damien O’Kane. Transcription is based on his playing on *Summer Hill*. The tilde indicates picked triplets on the banjo, which is tuned a semitone up on the album.

The tune has also been recorded on Brian Finnegan’s *The Ravishing Genius of Bones*, where it is played on guitar tuned FCFBCF (i.e. DADGAD with capo on 3). The guitar version is slightly different:
